name: ashui-canvaskit
description: Interactive 2D canvases and 3D scenes for ashui.
releasenote: SceneKit subdivision cages, splines and lathe surfaces, translation, rotation and scale gizmos, world orientation controls and selection masks with silhouette highlights. Scenes run in a page. Paused canvases release their frame ticker so idle windows can sleep. Uses ashui 0.1.3.
